item.title: OpenHack AI Engineer & Mosyle: Mac Security Revolution
item.description: Explore how OpenHack’s AI‑driven security engineer and Mosyle’s unified platform are reshaping Mac vulnerability hunting, Apple bounty programs, and enterprise defenses. This article dives deep into the tech, industry impact, and future outlook of these cutting‑edge solutions and what it means for developers, security teams, and Apple users worldwide.
